summary: Single UnifiedExpressionVisitor dispatching all expression node types via function registry lookup. Detects backend, resolves function definitions, recursively visits child nodes, and calls appropriate backend methods with protocol-aware argument resolution.

key_classes.name: UnifiedExpressionVisitor
key_classes.purpose: Single visitor replacing 12+ category-specific visitors; handles all node types via visit_* methods; uses FunctionRegistry for method resolution

key_functions.name: visit(node)
key_functions.purpose: Main entry point dispatching to node.accept(self)

key_functions.name: visit_scalar_function(node)
key_functions.purpose: Core dispatch: resolves function_key via registry, introspects protocol signature, calls backend method

key_functions.name: _resolve_argument(arg, param)
key_functions.purpose: Protocol-aware argument resolution: visits SubstraitNodes recursively, wraps raw values via lit()

extension_points: New node types require new visit_* methods
New function keys auto-resolved through registry
lifecycle_notes: Per unified-visitor principle: single visitor dispatches all expression node types
Relation visitor composes with expression visitor for embedded expressions
risks: Protocol introspection via inspect.signature() at visit time could have performance implications

evidence.detail: 571 lines; single class with visit_* methods
